scope: Evasive category transition and Power Up Evasive audit

findings.details: The current Evasive Skill reference says there are two Power Up Evasives available for CaCs, but its listed users are Recoome for Final Pose and Burter/Jeice/Dyspo for Mach Dash. Individual pages likewise identify these as cast skills. Treat the 'available for CaCs' wording as a source-table inconsistency and preserve the documented user/access evidence.

Previous Batch 221 corrected Mach Dash as an Evasive but placed it in the wrong stamina/provenance context. This batch records the current individual-page values and the category membership without rewriting historical data.
